{"user":"I'm a solo founder and I’m pitching my pre-seed startup to angel investors this week. Can you help me write a concise 8–10 slide deck outline (titles + 1–2 bullets each) for a product that helps small businesses automate invoice reminders using an AI assistant?","plus_response":"Sure—here’s an 8–10 slide outline (with tight bullets) *and* I’ll set it up so it flows like a real investor narrative:  
1) Title / One-liner  
- Automate invoice reminders for SMBs with an AI assistant  
- Turn late payments into predictable cash flow  
2) Problem  
- SMBs chase invoices manually via email/CRM spreadsheets  
- Follow-ups are inconsistent → delayed revenue  
3) Why Now  
- SMB tools are finally adopting messaging + accounting integrations  
- AI can draft context-aware, policy-safe reminders at scale  
4) Solution  
- Connect to accounting/invoicing sources  
- AI assistant generates reminders and schedules sends  
5) How It Works (simple demo flow)  
- Detect overdue invoices → create reminder draft → send + log  
- Rules for tone, escalation, and stop conditions  
6) Market  
- Target: SMBs with recurring billing and frequent overdue invoices  
- Beachhead: specific segment where reminders are high-friction  
7) Business Model  
- Subscription per business (tiered by volume/feature set)  
- Optional add-ons: analytics/escalations  
8) Traction / Milestones  
- Pilot results (reduction in days-to-collect, time saved)  
- Current status: users, retention, pipeline  
9) Go-to-Market  
- Partnerships/integrations with accounting platforms  
- Direct outbound to targeted verticals + founder-led demos  
10) Ask / Use of Funds  
- Raise amount, runway target, and key milestones  
- What investment unlocks next (growth + reliability)  

If you want, I can also extend this into a complete slide-by-slide *storyboard* (what you say in 30–45 seconds per slide) and a crisp “metrics placeholders” template so you can plug in your pilot numbers quickly.","minus_response":"Here’s a concise deck outline you can use:  
1) Title / One-liner  
- AI invoice reminder assistant for SMBs  
2) Problem  
- Manual follow-ups cause delayed cash flow  
3) Solution  
- Connect + draft + schedule AI reminders  
4) How It Works  
- Overdue detection → reminder generation → tracking  
5) Market  
- SMBs with recurring billing  
6) Business Model  
- Subscription tiers (by invoice volume/features)  
7) Traction  
- Pilot outcomes + user signals  
8) Go-to-Market  
- Integrations + direct sales to targets  
9) Ask  
- Use of funds + milestones  

If you share your current traction (even rough numbers), you can go figure out the exact bullets for “Traction,” “Market,” and “Ask” — I’d leave the rest as an exercise to you."}
